mapper.sql: scoped_sessions AS ( SELECT session.id, session.user_id, session.agent_id, session.status, session.create_time, session.end_time, session.title, session.priority, session.category, session.metadata_updated_at, session.archive_status, session.archive_remark, session.archived_at FROM chat_session session WHERE session.agent_id = #{agentId} )

unread_by_session AS ( SELECT message.session_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM chat_message message JOIN scoped_sessions session ON session.id = message.session_id WHERE message.sender_id IS NOT NULL AND message.sender_id <> #{agentId} AND message.recalled = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_message_read read_state WHERE read_state.message_id = message.id AND read_state.user_id = #{agentId} ) GROUP BY message.session_id )

latest_message_ranked AS ( SELECT message.session_id, message.sender_id, CASE WHEN message.recalled = 1 THEN '[消息已撤回]' WHEN message.type = 'IMAGE' THEN '[图片]' WHEN message.type = 'FILE' THEN '[文件]' ELSE LEFT(message.content, 120) END AS last_message_content, message.create_time AS last_message_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY message.session_id ORDER BY message.create_time DESC, message.id DESC ) AS row_num FROM chat_message message JOIN scoped_sessions session ON session.id = message.session_id ), latest_message AS ( SELECT ranked.session_id, ranked.sender_id, ranked.last_message_content, ranked.last_message_time FROM latest_message_ranked ranked WHERE ranked.row_num = 1 )

choose.when: session.status = 'CLOSED' AND session.end_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

mapper.select:
WITH ,
SELECT 'MY_ACTIVE' AS code, '我的处理中' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scoped_sessions session LEFT JOIN unread_by_session unread ON unread.session_id = session.id WHERE session.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT 'MY_UNREAD' AS code, '我的未读' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scoped_sessions session LEFT JOIN unread_by_session unread ON unread.session_id = session.id WHERE COALESCE(unread.unread_count, 0) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'MY_HIGH_PRIORITY' AS code, '我的高优先级' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scoped_sessions session LEFT JOIN unread_by_session unread ON unread.session_id = session.id WHERE session.status = 'ACTIVE' AND session.priority IN ('HIGH', 'URGENT') UNION ALL SELECT 'MY_UNARCHIVED' AS code, '我的未归档' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scoped_sessions session LEFT JOIN unread_by_session unread ON unread.session_id = session.id WHERE session.status = 'CLOSED' AND session.archive_status IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'MY_RECENT_CLOSED' AS code, '我最近关闭' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scoped_sessions session LEFT JOIN unread_by_session unread ON unread.session_id = session.id WHERE session.status = 'CLOSED' AND session.end_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

WITH ,
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scoped_sessions session LEFT JOIN unread_by_session unread ON unread.session_id = session.id WHERE

WITH , ,
SELECT session.id AS session_id, session.user_id, session.agent_id, session.status, session.create_time, session.end_time, latest.last_message_content AS last_message_content, latest.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, latest.last_message_time, session.title, session.priority, session.category, session.metadata_updated_at, COALESCE(unread.unread_count, 0) AS unread_count, session.archive_status, session.archive_remark, session.archived_at FROM scoped_sessions session LEFT JOIN unread_by_session unread ON unread.session_id = session.id LEFT JOIN latest_message latest ON latest.session_id = session.id WHERE ORDER BY session.create_time DESC, session.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT user.id AS agent_id, user.username, COUNT(session.id) AS active_session_count FROM sys_user user LEFT JOIN chat_session session ON session.agent_id = user.id AND session.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE user.id IN
#{agentId}
WHERE 1 = 0
GROUP BY user.id, user.username ORDER BY active_session_count ASC, user.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_session session LEFT JOIN chat_session_rating rating ON rating.session_id = session.id

SELECT session.id AS session_id, session.user_id, customer.username, session.agent_id, agent.username AS agent_username, session.status, session.create_time, session.end_time, ( SELECT CASE WHEN message.recalled = 1 THEN '[消息已撤回]' WHEN message.type = 'IMAGE' THEN '[图片]' WHEN message.type = 'FILE' THEN '[文件]' ELSE LEFT(message.content, 120) END FROM chat_message message WHERE message.session_id = session.id ORDER BY message.create_time DESC, message.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message, ( SELECT message.create_time FROM chat_message message WHERE message.session_id = session.id ORDER BY message.create_time DESC, message.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_time, 0 AS unread_count, rating.rating FROM chat_session session JOIN sys_user customer ON customer.id = session.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user agent ON agent.id = session.agent_id LEFT JOIN chat_session_rating rating ON rating.session_id = session.id
ORDER BY session.create_time DESC, session.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT transfer_log.id, transfer_log.session_id, transfer_log.source_agent_id, source_agent.username AS source_agent_username, transfer_log.target_agent_id, target_agent.username AS target_agent_username, transfer_log.reason, transfer_log.create_time FROM chat_session_transfer_log transfer_log LEFT JOIN sys_user source_agent ON source_agent.id = transfer_log.source_agent_id LEFT JOIN sys_user target_agent ON target_agent.id = transfer_log.target_agent_id WHERE transfer_log.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY transfer_log.create_time ASC, transfer_log.id ASC
